name: lattice-dimers
description: Domino and domicule tilings and the dimer entropy of the king's graph: exact counts on rectangles, cylinders and tori, rigorous bounds, papers, OEIS entries and a gallery that draws any tiling.

scripts.benchmark: node benchmarks/benchmarkRunner.js -n 1000 -m 7 && node benchmarks/benchmarkRunner.js -n 1000 -o 7 --only dominoTilingSolver-Formula.js && node benchmarks/benchmarkRunner.js -n 10 -m 2 -o 7 --only dominoTilingSolver-BigInt.js && node benchmarks/benchmarkRunner.js -n 1 -o 9 --only dominoTilingSolver-BigInt.js
scripts.benchmark:domicule: node benchmarks/benchmarkRunner.js --domicule -n 10 -m 9 && node benchmarks/benchmarkRunner.js --domicule -n 1 -o 9 --only domiculeTilingSolver-Modular.js && node benchmarks/benchmarkRunner.js --domicule -n 1 -o 9 --only domiculeTilingSolver-BigInt.js
scripts.benchmark:periodic: node benchmarks/benchmarkRunner.js --torus -n 10 -m 4 && node benchmarks/benchmarkRunner.js --torus -n 10 -o 4 -m 1 --only periodicTilingSolver-Modular.js && node benchmarks/benchmarkRunner.js --torus -n 1 -o 4 -m 1 --only periodicTilingSolver-BigInt.js && node benchmarks/benchmarkRunner.js --torus -n 1 -o 5 --only periodicTilingSolver-Modular.js && node benchmarks/benchmarkRunner.js --cylinder -n 10 -m 6 && node benchmarks/benchmarkRunner.js --cylinder -n 10 -o 6 --only periodicTilingSolver-Modular.js
scripts.benchmark:diagonal: node benchmarks/benchmarkRunner.js --diagonal -n 10 -m 7 && node benchmarks/benchmarkRunner.js --diagonal -n 10 -o 7 -m 2 --only domiculeDiagonalSolver-Modular.js && node benchmarks/benchmarkRunner.js --diagonal -n 1 -o 9 --only domiculeDiagonalSolver-Modular.js
